skinChoice.title: Current Color Scheme
skinChoice.description: Candidate window color scheme: light for system light mode, dark for dark mode.
skinChoice.colorScheme.label: Light color scheme
skinChoice.colorSchemeDark.label: Dark color scheme
skinChoice.colorSchemeDark.description: Color scheme used in system dark mode
layoutBehavior.title: Layout & Behavior
layoutBehavior.description: Candidate window orientation and interaction behavior. Key names verified against the Weasel 0.17 source.
layoutBehavior.layoutType.label: Layout
layoutBehavior.layoutType.description: horizontal for horizontal, vertical for vertical, vertical_text for vertical text (character by character); this key takes precedence over legacy keys such as horizontal
layoutBehavior.inlinePreedit.label: Inline preedit
layoutBehavior.inlinePreedit.description: Shows the preedit text at the app cursor
layoutBehavior.preeditType.label: Preedit content
layoutBehavior.preeditType.description: composition shows the typed code; preview shows the first candidate at the cursor (like Squirrel's inline candidate); preview_all shows all candidates inline
layoutBehavior.labelFormat.label: Label format
layoutBehavior.markText.label: Marker character
layoutBehavior.markText.description: Marker shown before the highlighted candidate, e.g. "·"
layoutBehavior.pagingOnScroll.label: Mouse-wheel paging
layoutBehavior.pagingOnScroll.descriptio: Scroll the mouse wheel over the candidate window to page
layoutBehavior.hoverType.label: Hover effect
layoutBehavior.hoverType.description: Effect of hovering over a candidate: none for none, semi_light for a translucent highlight, hilite for a full highlight
layoutBehavior.candidateAbbreviateLength: Candidates longer than this many characters are shortened with an ellipsis in the middle; 0 disables it
verticalText.title: Vertical Text Details
verticalText.description: Takes effect when the layout is vertical or vertical_text.
verticalText.verticalTextLeftToRight.des: Orders vertical_text columns left to right instead of the default right to left
verticalText.verticalTextWithWrap.label: Wrap to next column
verticalText.verticalTextWithWrap.descri: Starts a new column when vertical_text overflows one column
verticalText.verticalAutoReverse.label: Auto reverse direction
verticalText.verticalAutoReverse.descrip: Reverses the vertical direction based on the window position on screen
rendering.title: Rendering & Hints
rendering.antialiasMode.label: Font antialiasing
rendering.antialiasMode.description: Antialiasing for DirectWrite text: default follows the system, cleartype, grayscale, aliased disables it
rendering.asciiTipFollowCursor.label: Tip follows cursor
rendering.asciiTipFollowCursor.descripti: Shows the Chinese/English switching tip at the app cursor
rendering.fullscreen.label: Fullscreen apps
rendering.fullscreen.description: Shows the candidate window over fullscreen apps (games, players); enabling it turns off inline preedit and lifts the max width limit
rendering.displayTrayIcon.label: Show tray icon
layoutFonts.title: Fonts
layoutFonts.fontFace.label: Candidate font
layoutFonts.fontFace.description: Choose from installed system fonts, e.g. Microsoft YaHei
layoutFonts.fontPoint.label: Candidate font size
layoutFonts.labelFontFace.label: Label font
layoutFonts.labelFontPoint.label: Label font size
layoutFonts.commentFontFace.label: Comment font
layoutFonts.commentFontPoint.label: Comment font size
layoutSpacing.title: Spacing
layoutSpacing.spacing.label: Preedit-candidate spacing
layoutSpacing.candidateSpacing.label: Candidate spacing
layoutSpacing.hiliteSpacing.label: Label-candidate spacing
layoutSpacing.hilitePadding.label: Highlight padding
layoutSpacing.hilitePadding.description: Pixels the highlight background expands around the candidate
layoutSpacing.lineSpacing.label: Candidate line spacing
layoutCorners.title: Corners & Margins
layoutCorners.cornerRadius.label: Corner radius
layoutCorners.hilitedCornerRadius.label: Highlight corner radius
layoutCorners.borderWidth.label: Border width
layoutCorners.borderWidth.description: Candidate window outline in pixels; the color comes from the color scheme's border_color
layoutCorners.marginX.label: Horizontal margin
layoutCorners.marginX.description: Left and right padding between the window content and its edge
layoutCorners.marginY.label: Vertical margin
layoutCorners.marginY.description: Top and bottom padding between the window content and its edge
layoutShadow.title: Shadow
layoutShadow.description: Visible only when the color scheme provides a non-transparent shadow_color.
layoutShadow.shadowRadius.label: Shadow corner radius
layoutShadow.shadowRadius.description: Blur radius of the candidate window shadow
layoutShadow.shadowOffsetX.label: Shadow X offset
layoutShadow.shadowOffsetY.label: Shadow Y offset
layoutSize.title: Size Limits
layoutSize.minWidth.label: Min width
layoutSize.minHeight.label: Min height
layoutSize.maxWidth.label: Max width
layoutSize.maxHeight.label: Max height
layoutAlign.title: Alignment & Baseline
layoutAlign.alignType.label: Vertical alignment
layoutAlign.alignType.description: Text alignment reference within a candidate row (top / middle / bottom)
layoutAlign.baseline.label: Baseline adjustment
layoutAlign.baseline.description: Nudges the text baseline by a percentage of the candidate font size; 0 means no adjustment
appOptions.title: Applications
appOptions.description: Set input behavior per application (by program exe name, e.g. English by default in terminals). This section is edited as a card list on the App Behavior page; changes are saved to the patch and take effect after redeploy.
appOptions.appsTable.label: App list
